intro.title: County Clerk
intro.description: The County Clerk provides administrative assistance to the County Administrator and Board of Commissioners in support of the overall administration of county government.

responsibility_paragraphs: This office is located in the Administrative Building at 800 Chandler St.
The County Clerk is responsible for providing administrative assistance to the County Administrator and Board of Commissioners for the overall administration of county government.
The County Clerk attends Commission meetings and compiles and records meeting minutes. This office is also responsible for personnel records and county payroll.
